entities.name: Unitree
entities.summary: 宇树科技. Hangzhou-based vertically-integrated leg-locomotion-robot maker founded 2016 by 王兴兴 (Wang Xingxing). Global price-floor setter: Go2 quadruped from USD 1,600, G1 humanoid from USD 16k (vs ~USD 75k for Boston Dynamics Spot). Filed A-share IPO guidance Jul-2025; latest disclosed C round Feb-2025 implied ~USD 1.7-2 bn, with rumoured later-stage paper at ~USD 5 bn. ~1,500 employees mid-2025.

entities.name: Deep Robotics
entities.summary: 云深处科技. Hangzhou-based quadruped maker founded 2017. Jueying X20 industrial + Lite3 consumer/edu lines, priced ~30% above Unitree at comparable specs. Strong in China State Grid substation inspection. ~USD 0.7 bn last disclosed valuation.

entities.name: ANYbotics
entities.summary: Swiss ETH-Zurich spinout (2016); ANYmal D/X high-end industrial-inspection quadruped — best terrain capability in the segment. Customers in offshore oil&gas, mining, substation inspection. ~USD 50 m Series C in 2024.

entities.name: Ghost Robotics
entities.summary: Philadelphia-based defense-focused quadruped maker; Vision 60 delivered to multiple US military branches and US Customs and Border Protection. South Korea's LIG Nex1 took a strategic stake in 2024.

entities.name: Agility Robotics
entities.summary: Bipedal-humanoid maker; Digit deployed at Amazon and GXO Logistics warehouses since 2023 — by deployed hours, the most-production-scaled bipedal robot globally.

entities.name: LimX Dynamics
entities.summary: 逐际动力. Shenzhen-based Chinese humanoid-robot startup.

entities.name: Leju Robotics

entities.name: Xiaomi
entities.summary: Smartphones + EV maker; built the CyberOne humanoid as an internal product — a peer to Unitree's G1 within China's humanoid landscape.

entities.name: BMW
